description: Form 6252 line 26: property held 1 year or less goes to Form 4797 line 10. Equipment held under a year (cost $25,000, depreciation $5,000, price $30,000, $10,000 received): gain $10,000, § 1245 recapture $5,000 taxed now (line 12); line 14 $5,000 over a $30,000 contract price — $1,666.67 of the $10,000 payment. Form 4797 line 17 = $1,666.67 + $5,000.
